svg.text: Wireframe · 3 Pipelines: the canvas is the editor (expert mode) · Ingest Studio redesign, draft for the owner, 4 November 2026
Pipeline: Visits and contacts · draft from v4 · target: Prison Intelligence Dataset (model v3)
Left to right: source tables → staging steps → map to the target model → load. Click a node: its editor opens on the right, with a live sample.
+ Source table + Staging step ▾ + Extract + Enrich · Save draft is automatic · Show YAML
Node colours: grey = source, teal = staging, blue = map. Dashed = expert-only step (SQL, fuzzy match): disclosed in every run report.
Threshold 0.85 [────●──] below threshold: keep row, no match
A match here is written as a scored SAME_AS link, marked inferred,
with the score and this version's threshold in its provenance. It is
never a merge: an analyst can confirm or undo it in the Glass.
(Overrides ADR-006 only for this step, by the owner's ruling, 4 Nov 2026.)
Guided mode shows this pipeline as a numbered list of steps; this step is read-only there.
